name: Soroush Khanlou
bio: Soroush Khanlou is a New York-based iOS developer. He freelanced for many years, for companies like Adobe, Betterment, and non-profits like Urban Archive, and now he works as an accessibility engineer at Square. He blogs about programming at khanlou.com. In his free time, he hikes, bakes bread and pastries, and collects suitcases.
